rules.statement: Where a plaintiff brings an action in one capacity, it is not competent for the defendant to put in a claim against him in reconvention in another capacity.
rules.supporting_quote: This is the case of a person who sues in one capacity and is called upon to meet a claim in reconvention made against him in another. In deciding this question we are not governed by any specific section of the Civil Procedure Code. We have to apply the general principles of the Common law with regard to reconvention which are discussed in the case of Silva v. Perera.
